_comment: CW single-track 316L calibration. Thermophysical params calibrated ONCE, shared across ALL cases; only process params (P, v, radius) and geometry differ per case. Edit ranges/budget here.

objective._comment: Per case: error = mean(|depth_err|, |width_err|). Candidate objective = mean over all cases. Lower is better.

optimizer._comment: 32 candidates total (baseline + 31 LHS). Each candidate runs ALL 3 cases. 12 free params -> 32 samples is a reasonable screening budget.

parameters._comment: Shared 316L thermophysical knobs. Ranges stay within published literature bounds. cp_scale/kappa_scale are multiplicative on the SOLID table; liquid slope is additive dX/dT for T>=Tliquidus. Marangoni_Constant is negative (dσ/dT).

kappa_liquid_slope._units: W/m/K/K, additive dkappa/dT for T>=Tliquidus, capped at Tvap

cp_liquid_slope._units: J/kg/K/K, additive dcp/dT for T>=Tliquidus, capped at Tvap

geometry._comment: Common geometry constants in metres. Per-case y/z extents computed from these + process/target.

cases.name: case_P200_v900_r40
cases._exp_rows: Hofmann row 111 (P200 v900 d0.08 t_powder=0 balling=0)

earlyAbort._comment: Abort once melt-pool STABILIZED (rel change last two points < stabilityTol) AND error > 50%. If case1 > 50% off, skip remaining cases for that candidate.

cleanup._comment: Disk saver: keep ONLY the best-so-far candidate's full data (VTK + processor*/). When a candidate completes with a lower objective it becomes the new best and the previous best is stripped; every non-best candidate is stripped as soon as it finishes. The tiny post-processing CSV, logs and case_build.json are always kept, so scoring is unaffected.

execution._comment: maxParallel = floor(totalCores / coresPerSim) = 8 parallel sims. Override with env CALIB_TOTAL_CORES / CALIB_CORES_PER_SIM (HPC sets these via job_calibration.sh).
